evidencePolicy: A capability is not verified until its declared Flutter evidence and cross-consumer comparison have been executed. Evidence flags describe executed checks; supportLevel and evidenceStatus still determine whether the capability is active, partial, Flutter-only, or unsupported.

evidenceDefinitions.localFlutterTests: The relevant Flutter unit, widget, golden, or conformance test has passed in the local runner.
evidenceDefinitions.sharedFixtures: The check consumed a canonical workspace fixture through the portable fixture adapter; this does not make a capability part of the active contract.
evidenceDefinitions.semanticParity: The declared semantic projection matched the TypeScript expected snapshot under the documented normalization and tolerance rules.
evidenceDefinitions.ci: The same declared evidence passed in the official integration workflow from a clean checkout.
evidenceDefinitions.activeContractBoundary: A capability candidate remains partial until an explicit contract decision promotes it to the active fixture/baseline; local evidence alone never performs that promotion.
